description: 3-stage path traversal via Unicode NFKC normalization applied AFTER sanitization: (1) add dynamic theme asset serving with ../ sanitization, (2) add cross-platform filename normalization at upload time, (3) apply the same normalization on retrieval to support legacy unnormalized entries. The NFKC form of U+FF0F (fullwidth slash) is /, so '..／..／etc／passwd' passes the sanitizer but normalizes to '../../etc/passwd' before filepath.Join.
